meanings.en: turning around a central point, like a wheel
meanings.exampleEn: The old phone had a rotary dial instead of buttons.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski telefonda tuşlar yerine döner bir kadran vardı.

meanings.en: past tense of rot; decayed naturally
meanings.exampleEn: The fallen apples rotted on the ground over the winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşen elmalar kış boyunca yerde çürüdü.

meanings.en: an approximate estimate rather than an exact figure
meanings.exampleEn: By my rough calculation, the trip will cost about a thousand dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Kabaca hesabıma göre, gezi yaklaşık bin dolara mal olacak.

meanings.en: the quality of having an uneven or coarse surface or manner
meanings.exampleEn: You could feel the roughness of the unpolished wood.
meanings.exampleTr: Cilalanmamış tahtanın pürüzlülüğünü hissedebiliyordun.

meanings.en: a vehicle for driving over rough terrain, especially on another planet
meanings.exampleEn: The Mars rover sent back stunning images of the red planet.
meanings.exampleTr: Mars keşif aracı kızıl gezegenin çarpıcı görüntülerini geri gönderdi.

meanings.en: a person who wanders from place to place
meanings.exampleEn: He was a rover at heart, never settling in one town for long.
meanings.exampleTr: Ruhunda bir gezgindi, hiçbir kasabada uzun süre kalmazdı.

meanings.en: noisy and rough, often in a disorderly way
meanings.exampleEn: A rowdy crowd of fans filled the stadium.
meanings.exampleTr: Gürültücü bir taraftar kalabalığı stadyumu doldurdu.

meanings.en: a place where waste is dumped or disposed of (British English)
meanings.exampleEn: The council opened a new rubbish site on the edge of town.
meanings.exampleTr: Belediye kasabanın kenarında yeni bir çöp döküm sahası açtı.

meanings.en: a red precious stone
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a ring set with a single, deep-red ruby.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir koyu kırmızı yakutla süslü bir yüzük takıyordu.

meanings.en: a violent or lawless person
meanings.exampleEn: A gang of ruffians threatened the shopkeeper for money.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir grup kabadayı, dükkan sahibini para için tehdit etti.

meanings.en: a person who lives in the countryside
meanings.exampleEn: Many rural residents have to travel far to reach a hospital.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok kırsal bölge sakini bir hastaneye ulaşmak için uzağa gitmek zorunda.

meanings.en: covered with rust; corroded by moisture (past tense of rust)
meanings.exampleEn: The old gate had rusted shut over the years.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kapı yıllar içinde paslanıp açılmaz olmuştu.

meanings.en: a boring, unchanging routine that is hard to escape
meanings.exampleEn: After ten years in the same job, she felt stuck in a rut.
meanings.exampleTr: Aynı işte on yıl geçirdikten sonra kendini tekdüze bir düzene sıkışmış hissetti.

meanings.en: a deep, narrow track made by wheels in soft ground
meanings.exampleEn: The cart's wheels left deep ruts in the muddy road.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın tekerlekleri çamurlu yolda derin izler bıraktı.

meanings.en: a large vehicle equipped for living in, used for travel and holidays
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the summer touring the country in their RV.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazı karavanlarıyla ülkeyi gezerek geçirdiler.

meanings.en: the deliberate destruction or obstruction of something
meanings.exampleEn: The factory fire was later found to be an act of sabotage.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika yangınının daha sonra bir sabotaj eylemi olduğu ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: to deliberately damage or ruin something
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to sabotage his rival's presentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Rakibinin sunumunu baltalamaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: disrespect or violation of something sacred
meanings.exampleEn: Damaging the ancient temple was seen as an act of sacrilege.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik tapınağa zarar vermek kutsala saygısızlık olarak görüldü.

meanings.en: showing disrespect for something regarded as sacred
meanings.exampleEn: It felt sacrilegious to speak loudly inside the old cathedral.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski katedralin içinde yüksek sesle konuşmak kutsala saygısızlık gibi geliyordu.

meanings.en: made sad or unhappy (past tense of sadden)
meanings.exampleEn: We were deeply saddened by the news of his death.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölüm haberinden derinden üzüldük.

meanings.en: a boat that is moved through the water by sails
meanings.exampleEn: They watched a small sailing boat glide across the bay.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük bir yelkenli teknenin körfezde süzülüşünü izlediler.

meanings.en: a holy person honoured by a church after death
meanings.exampleEn: The church was named after a medieval saint.
meanings.exampleTr: Kilise ortaçağdan bir azizin adını taşıyordu.

meanings.en: a very good, kind, or patient person
meanings.exampleEn: You must be a saint to put up with all that noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Bunca gürültüye katlanmak için melek gibi biri olmalısın.

meanings.en: a soothing ointment for wounds or sore skin
meanings.exampleEn: She rubbed a soothing salve onto the burn.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanığa yatıştırıcı bir merhem sürdü.

meanings.en: something that soothes or comforts feelings
meanings.exampleEn: His kind words were a salve to her wounded pride.
meanings.exampleTr: Nazik sözleri, yaralı gururuna bir teselli oldu.

meanings.en: to make something holy or set it apart as sacred
meanings.exampleEn: The priest sanctified the new chapel with a special ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahip özel bir törenle yeni şapeli kutsadı.

meanings.en: went below the surface of water (past tense of sink)
meanings.exampleEn: The ship struck an iceberg and sank within hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi bir buzdağına çarptı ve saatler içinde battı.

meanings.en: a writer or performer who uses humour to criticize people or society
meanings.exampleEn: The satirist mocked politicians in his weekly column.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiciv yazarı, haftalık köşesinde politikacılarla alay etti.

meanings.en: to walk in a slow, relaxed, and unhurried way
meanings.exampleEn: He sauntered down the street with his hands in his pockets.
meanings.exampleTr: Elleri ceplerinde, sokakta aylak aylak yürüdü.

meanings.en: fierce, violent, and uncontrolled
meanings.exampleEn: The dog launched a savage attack on the intruder.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek, davetsiz misafire vahşi bir saldırı başlattı.

meanings.en: extremely harsh or severe
meanings.exampleEn: The film received savage reviews from the critics.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, eleştirmenlerden çok sert eleştiriler aldı.

meanings.en: in a fierce, violent, or cruel way
meanings.exampleEn: The victim had been savagely beaten.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurban vahşice dövülmüştü.

meanings.en: extremely cruel and violent behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: The report described the savagery of the attack in shocking detail.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, saldırının vahşetini şok edici ayrıntılarla anlattı.

meanings.en: to run quickly with short, light steps, like a small animal or child
meanings.exampleEn: The squirrels scampered up the tree at the first sign of danger.
meanings.exampleTr: Sincaplar, tehlikenin ilk işaretinde ağaca seğirttiler.

meanings.tr: yetersizce, az; üstü başı açık şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that is insufficient or barely covering
meanings.exampleEn: The dancers were scantily dressed for the cold weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçılar soğuk hava için oldukça açık giyinmişlerdi.

meanings.en: too small in amount; barely enough
meanings.exampleEn: The survivors lived on scanty supplies of food and water.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayatta kalanlar kıt yiyecek ve su stoklarıyla yaşadılar.

meanings.en: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events
meanings.exampleEn: In the worst-case scenario, the whole project could fail.
meanings.exampleTr: En kötü senaryoda, tüm proje başarısız olabilir.

meanings.en: a person or program that arranges the timing of tasks or events
meanings.exampleEn: The app has a built-in scheduler to plan your meetings.
meanings.exampleTr: Uygulamada toplantılarınızı planlamak için yerleşik bir zamanlayıcı var.

meanings.en: showing contempt or a lack of respect
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a scornful laugh at his suggestion.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun önerisine küçümseyen bir kahkaha attı.

meanings.en: to search a place thoroughly and carefully
meanings.exampleEn: Police scoured the woods for the missing child.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis, kayıp çocuk için ormanı taradı.

meanings.en: to clean something by rubbing hard
meanings.exampleEn: She scoured the pot until it shone.
meanings.exampleTr: Tencereyi parlayana kadar ovaladı.

meanings.en: to make a loud, high, unpleasant sound
meanings.exampleEn: The car's tyres screeched as it stopped suddenly.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba aniden durunca lastikleri gıcırdadı.

meanings.en: to examine something very carefully and in detail
meanings.exampleEn: Investors scrutinized the company's financial records.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılar şirketin mali kayıtlarını dikkatle incelediler.

meanings.en: a short, confused fight or struggle
meanings.exampleEn: A scuffle broke out between the two fans outside the stadium.
meanings.exampleTr: Stadyumun dışında iki taraftar arasında bir arbede çıktı.

meanings.en: extremely hot or intense
meanings.exampleEn: They worked in the searing heat of the desert.
meanings.exampleTr: Çölün kavurucu sıcağında çalıştılar.

meanings.en: very harsh and critical
meanings.exampleEn: The article was a searing attack on the government.
meanings.exampleTr: Makale, hükümete yönelik çok sert bir saldırıydı.

meanings.en: quiet and private; away from other people
meanings.exampleEn: They found a secluded beach far from the tourists.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistlerden uzak, tenha bir plaj buldular.

meanings.en: the use of drugs to make someone calm or sleepy, often for medical reasons
meanings.exampleEn: The patient was kept under sedation during the procedure.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta işlem sırasında sakinleştirici etkisi altında tutuldu.

meanings.en: involving much sitting and little physical activity
meanings.exampleEn: A sedentary lifestyle can increase the risk of heart disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Hareketsiz bir yaşam tarzı kalp hastalığı riskini artırabilir.

meanings.en: past participle of see; perceived with the eyes
meanings.exampleEn: I have seen that film three times already.
meanings.exampleTr: O filmi zaten üç kez izledim.

meanings.en: preoccupied with your own thoughts, interests, or feelings
meanings.exampleEn: He is too self-absorbed to notice how others feel.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkalarının nasıl hissettiğini fark edemeyecek kadar kendine dönük biri.

meanings.tr: özveri, nefsine hakim olma, kendini yoksun bırakma
meanings.en: the act of not allowing yourself things you want, especially for a moral reason
meanings.exampleEn: Saving that much money required years of self-denial.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar para biriktirmek yıllarca özveri gerektirdi.
